slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Knees fine for the first hour, then grumbling by the end of the long ride? That's a common pattern.

A few usual suspects: saddle height, cleat and foot position, and big jumps in distance or climbing. A saddle that's too low often loads the front of the knee, and changes of a few millimetres can matter. A professional bike fit can help too.

Strength off the bike counts. Squats, step-ups and hip work twice a week can help your knees cope with longer rides.

Swelling, locking, giving way or pain that disrupts sleep or walking is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
